bookings.title: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel — timed entry
bookings.tip: Tickets open about 60 days ahead on the official Vatican Museums site and the early slots go first in busy months. Book there, not through resellers — and pack shoulder & knee coverage.

bookings.title: Colosseum underground + arena tour
bookings.tip: Underground (hypogeum) and arena-floor tickets are capacity-limited and released in batches on the official Colosseum site, typically around a month ahead. Set a reminder — they can sell out within hours in peak season.

bookings.title: Rome → Naples high-speed trains (Pompeii day)
bookings.tip: Frecciarossa and Italo fares work like airfares: cheaper the earlier you book. From Naples, the Circumvesuviana local train runs to Pompei Scavi — buy Pompeii site tickets online to skip the queue.

bookings.title: Borghese Gallery
bookings.tip: Advance booking is required: entry is by timed 2-hour slot and capacity is limited. Weekend slots can sell out weeks ahead. Bags must be checked, so travel light.

bookings.title: Rooftop dinner — Colosseum-view terrace
bookings.tip: Terrace tables for groups of 5+ go first. Ask for the terrace specifically and expect a set menu or card deposit for larger groups. Book around sunset for the photos.

bookings.title: Pasta & tiramisù cooking class
bookings.tip: Small-group classes often cap around 10–12 people, so a group of 5 can fill half a class. Book early and send dietary notes ahead of time.
